changes: RunMonitor optional on_status observer runs after successful journal append and snapshot replacement, with an isolated scalar/list snapshot copy.
Actual TaskRunner semantic children forward saved status to the root while the child is executing; global action/planning offsets are fixed for that child and counters retain their high-water values.
Root remains executing with child_<stage> detail; child terminal status does not finish the root or add semantic-goal completion. Only the outer verified ledger supplies subgoals_completed.

Existing ordinary observer callbacks remain chained. Ordinary Exception becomes a fixed status_observer_failed observer_failures diagnostic and warning; it is not retried or echoed with raw private exception text.
KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit are deliberately not swallowed. Cancellation remains a runtime cancellation/exit, not a telemetry fault rescued into success.

Semantic root status elapsed time now uses the monitor default independent monotonic clock, matching TaskRunner. Business self.clock, deadlines and budgets were not changed. Historical monitor timestamps/elapsed values remain untouched.
unchanged_contracts: Legacy status field sets and write_failures codes; observer diagnostics are separate property/log diagnostics.
Stage checks, caller final, input dispatch/unknown accounting, retry decisions, input and model budgets.
Status reader stale threshold and directory selection; no background heartbeat, polling thread, model call or desktop access is introduced.
limits: Status is event-driven. A long blocked model or bridge operation can still make the last record stale after 30 seconds; no heartbeat is claimed.
actions_used is telemetry, not an independent semantic-success or input-receipt proof. An unknown attempt remains visible without earning stage credit.
Callbacks and additional persistence have real wall-time overhead. Independent monitor timing prevents consumption of execution-clock fixture reads, not zero overhead.
No new actual desktop proof is supplied by these CPU tests. Same-final-source normal/transient runs and full regression are still required.
retained_first_result: 85 passed in 18.45s, followed by Ruff exit1 for three unbound closure variables; fixed in second validation, original outputs retained.
